name: DISCOVERY_STABILITY
findings: XBRL page byte-identical across two observations (SHA 6E7691D1...).
Discovery URIs (busqueda?id=X, em_inffinanual, datosentidad, webservices/verdocumento, Consulta-IP/OIR) identical: XBRL 27/27, homepage 65/65, zero diffs.
webservices/verdocumento/ver?t=%7b<guid>%7d pattern stable (29 occurrences in both observations); individual GUIDs are dynamic.
No ordering changes, no session dependence, identical output for identical parameters.
limitations: Observations within a ~20 min window; longer-horizon stability (menu/taxonomy changes) not covered.
